name: epoch-gated flaky stage for sandbox run proofs
description: Deterministic transient-failure scenario for petri run proofs on Docker sandboxes: gate the flaky stage on an epoch (script: if [ $(date +%s) -lt EPOCH ]; then exit 1; fi) with EPOCH = creation time + a few minutes. Run 1 fails terminally at the gated node before EPOCH; after EPOCH passes, retry/rewind re-runs the node and succeeds. No cross-run marker needed (a host-side marker file is invisible inside a Docker sandbox, and the restored workspace starts from the checkpoint anyway).
